title: Variance on a product space
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. Its variance under the product probability distribution $\pi^{\otimes n}$ is the expected squared deviation from its mean: $\mathbb E_{x\sim\pi^{\otimes n}}[(f(x)-\mathbb E_{y\sim\pi^{\otimes n}}f(y))^2]$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
